description: This file defines the React component ScheduleICU, which provides a weekly calendar UI for scheduling ICU bookings. It manages state for doctors, ICU rooms, booking data, and modal dialogs, and interacts with external APIs to fetch data and create bookings. It includes rendering logic for the calendar grid, date calculations for the current week, and event handlers for user interactions.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into 'YYYY-MM-DD' string.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a calendar cell; sets the selected date and time range, and opens the booking modal.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving a booking through the modal; updates local booking state and calls API to create the booking.

methods.name: cellHasBooking
methods.description: Checks if a specific date and time slot already has a booking.
